feature: NetSuite customers appear in the shared application customer directory after save
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); customer source confirmed by user
setup: Existing Node test runner, fast-check, c8, ESLint and TypeScript. No new dependencies, migrations, commits or production data writes. Standard isolated Compose with teardown registered before startup.
scenarios: Valid create returns 200 only after canonical customer, return projection and system audit commit; existing customer searches find it.
Repeated and concurrent delivery creates one customer and one canonical event; equivalent payload reports unchanged.
Newer updates replace source-owned fields; older events are ignored; same-time conflicting values return 409 without overwriting.
Inactive customers disappear from active searches; no hard customer deletion or modification of unrelated customers or local site profiles.
Missing configuration returns 503; absent or wrong header secret returns 401; mirror consumer and wrong NetSuite account return 403.
Malformed JSON, invalid IDs, invalid timestamps, invalid currency, missing full snapshot fields and oversized bodies are rejected without database writes.
A persistence failure rolls back canonical record, return projection, canonical event, sync run and audit together and returns a retryable failure.
Sender runs on create/edit/xedit, loads the full saved customer (including inline edits), resolves actual currency ISO code and sends an authenticated HTTPS JSON snapshot.
Sender skips deletes and non-customer stages, reports configuration/HTTP/transport failures without logging secrets or customer payloads, and does not block the saved customer.
Existing customer sync, projection and source-ordering regression suites continue to pass. Production remains healthy; this task's test containers, volumes and networks are removed.

failureModel.unauthorizedWrite: HTTP credential, account-binding and malformed-input tests
failureModel.duplicateOrStaleWrite: PostgreSQL concurrency, replay and reordered-event tests
failureModel.partialWrite: Injected failure at audit boundary with real PostgreSQL rollback assertions
failureModel.customerNotVisible: Real HTTP to database to existing customer search integration tests
failureModel.partialInlineEdit: SuiteScript VM contract test that requires a record.load
failureModel.silentSenderFailure: Assertions on sanitized error logs for response and transport failures
failureModel.productionResourceExhaustion: mbbs-tests.slice, bounded Compose services, cleanup trap and production health readback

knownLimits: NetSuite script installation requires access to the user's NetSuite account.
No durable NetSuite outbound retry queue: failed sends are logged and can be replayed by saving the customer again.
No hard-delete propagation or removal of existing child addresses/contacts.
